messages:
Hannah T: Quick heads-up: Hosted API realtime and tool-calling features are GA today at 15:30 PT. This release unifies streaming and function/tool calls across REST + GraphQL. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted-ga-realtime :tada:

Marco V: Congrats! Is there a new endpoint or is it behind existing /v2/* paths?

Hannah T: New endpoints: `/v2/realtime` (REST) and `/v2/realtime/graphql` (GraphQL). Old /v1/stream remains for 90 days, compatibility shim available.

Olivia S: Any auth/workflow changes for customers trying tool-calls?

Hannah T: Same API keys. Tool-calls require explicit `tools` scope and a tool manifest in the request. Add header `x-rw-mode: realtime` to opt into streaming behavior. SEs will get emails for tenants with preapproved tool access.

deploy-bot: deploy #5510 completed -> prod (us-west-2) -> canary 15%

Billing-bot: Note: new pricing tier `realtime-standard` will be applied for streaming tokens starting next billing cycle. Intro credits will cover first month for active accounts.

Marco V: Are Dedicated/Private customers on the same GA timeline?

Hannah T: Dedicated: opt-in starts today for tenants with reserved capacity. Private: runtime image + manifest available via the customer registry next week. We'll run a migration webinar for SEs tomorrow.

Sam (cto): Great work across runtime, infra, and billing. Ops: watch p95 and error rates. If anything spikes, escalate to #incidents immediately.

Hannah T: Will do. If you spot migration issues or broken SDKs, ping @hannah.t or open a PR in the SDK repo. Migration checklist and small code samples are in the docs. Thanks team! :rocket:
